response.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005

assumptions.assumption: High-rebate means rebrate strictly greater than 0.0005 (the cutoff itself is excluded).
Average net fee rate is the mean of (feerate - rebrate) per record; rows where either rate is NULL are ignored by AVG. SUM and AVG return NULL when no rows qualify.

alternatives.interpretation: High-rebate means rebrate at or above 0.0005 (cutoff inclusive).
alternatives.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
